description: Permanently delete a custom source tag and all its pattern assignments; retain source records. Built-in tags and Owned/Competitor cannot be deleted; remove patterns from a built-in tag instead. Read the listing first and pass the tag's revision as expected-revision. Obtain explicit user confirmation identifying the tag and its patterns before calling. MCP executes immediately after authorization; Athena AI chat presents an approval card. If the tag changed, read again. Never retry a declined proposal unless asked. A false analytics-refresh result means the tag was deleted but filtered analytics may still be cached.

expected_revision.description: Revision returned by the source-tag listing tool for this tag.

tag_id.description: Custom source tag ID returned by the source-tag listing tool.

name: source_tags__delete
